scientific_limitations: The claim is for adjacent nonzero binomial coefficients modulo p in the first p^r rows; no extension to arbitrary cutoffs or prime-power quotient moduli is asserted. Two broad historical sources were accessible only through abstracts and metadata; an implicit older formulation remains a priority risk.
source_date_basis: Cambridge online public date 2002-01-30 for the 2001 Barat--Grabner work; earlier works are cited with year-only or month-only publication evidence, not assigned invented daily public dates.
title: Adjacent nonzero Pascal quotients: an all-prime exact spectrum and persistent quadratic dependence
